description: This file defines a template class 'AtomicHook' used for implementing thread-safe, atomic function hooks in the Abseil C++ library. It provides mechanisms to register, load, and invoke hooks with proper memory ordering guarantees, and handles platform-specific atomic support.

classes.name: AtomicHook<ReturnType (*)(Args...)>
classes.description: A template class that manages an atomic function pointer hook, allowing registration and invocation of hooks with thread safety.

methods.name: AtomicHook()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the hook to a no-op.

methods.name: AtomicHook(FnPtr default_fn)
methods.description: Constructor that sets the default function pointer for the hook.

methods.name: void Store(FnPtr fn)
methods.description: Stores a function pointer atomically as the hook.

methods.name: template <typename... CallArgs> ReturnType operator()(CallArgs&&... args) const
methods.description: Invokes the registered hook with provided arguments.

methods.name: FnPtr Load() const
methods.description: Returns the currently registered hook function pointer, or nullptr if none.
